content: अवरोहः .²1 Descent, going or coming down. .²2 A creeping plant winding itself round a tree from the bottom to the top (such as the गुडूची creeper). .²3 Heaven (तस्माद्धि भोगावसाने सर्वेऽवरोहन्ति). .²4 Mounting, ascending. .²5 A shoot sent out by a plant, a pendent branch, one that strikes fresh roots into the earth, as of the fig-tree (वट); अवरोहशताकीर्णं वटमासाद्य तस्थतुः <ls>Rām.</ls> .²6 The growth of a plant or vine. .²7 (In music) The descending scale of notes.
